annotation.title_clean: Guidelines on the ethical use of artificial intelligence and data in teaching and learning
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on the ethical use of artificial intelligence and data in teaching and learning
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, DG Education, Youth, Sport and Culture
annotation.venue: European Commission – Education and Training website
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page presenting the updated 2026 guidelines on the ethical use of AI and data in teaching and learning for primary and secondary educators. It describes the guidelines' contents (scenarios, AI Act and GDPR context, glossary), their timeline, and Erasmus+ funding. It has no embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Updated 2026 guidelines support teachers in the ethical use of AI and data
Covers AI Act, GDPR and responsible AI principles
Includes guiding questions, scenarios and a glossary
First published in 2022, updated by the Working Group via the European Digital Education Hub
Erasmus+ calls fund policy experimentation on AI in education
